newsitem.title: FRANCE: Airbus has A320 order, 4 firm, 4 options.
newsitem.headline: Airbus has A320 order, 4 firm, 4 options.

text.p: European aircraft consortium Airbus Industrie said on Friday that Colombian airline ACES had placed four firm orders and taken four options for its A320 aircraft.
Delivery of the first two 150-seat planes is scheduled for November 1997 and the following two will be delivered in July and October 1998.
The new A320 fleet will replace the Boeing B727s that ACES (Aerolineas Centrales de Colombia SA) uses to fly its domestic routes. They will also serve international destinations such as Miami.
Industry sources estimate list price of an A320 at around $47 million.

Airbus is a consortium made up of French state-owned Ste Nationale Industrielle Aerospatiale, British Aerospace Plc, Daimler-Benz Aerospace, a unit of Daimler-Benz AG, and Construcciones Aeronauticas SA (CASA) of Spain.
